name: sec08-mechanism-c-native-feasibility
min_abi_reason: LANDLOCK_SCOPE_SIGNAL and LANDLOCK_SCOPE_ABSTRACT_UNIX_SOCKET require ABI 6. The floor is not lowered when a runner is older, and a missing scope is a refusal before exec with no fallback.

entrypoint.starts_as: uid 0 in the harness supervisor, which stands in for the container entrypoint
entrypoint.transition: landlock_restrict_self with scoped signal and abstract-unix, clear supplementary groups, setresgid/setresuid to 10003, exec
entrypoint.executor_uid_10002: does not call setuid; CapEff stays empty. It only writes a delegated cgroup.kill file and connects to the control socket.

files.role: entrypoint, Landlock domain, tool probe, executor cancel
